_note: Where each field sits on each form type. 'exemplar' is a picture of one scan of the form (1500 px wide); 'fields' are [x1, y1, x2, y2] rectangles in that picture, covering the label, the value (handwriting included) and the caption printed under it, with a little room to spare. A page is lined up with the exemplar by form_templates.py, and these rectangles are moved to match. A field missing from 'fields' is not on that page of the form; a template with no fields marks a page we recognise that has none of the fields we collect. Add a form type by adding an entry and an exemplar image.
